Key Aspects
Learning
We prepare the next generation of scientists and scholars to make a difference in the world. Click here to learn about the BS, BA, MS, and Ph.D. degrees we offer as well as our minors, concentrations, and certificate programs.
Research
Research within the School falls into six categories that span three departments: climate change, sea-level rise, ocean destabilization, environment and biodiversity, urbanization, and Earth through space and time. Click to learn more.
Outreach
Outreach and education are an essential part of any research program. Click here to learn about the initiatives we're involved in to inspire K-12 students, enhance the Rowan community, and invite adults to share in the School experience.

About the School
Understanding the interactions between Earth systems, life on Earth, and human society is essential to a flourishing future for all of humanity. Our degree programs use hands-on experience to provide students and trainees with pathways into exciting and important modern careers. Our outstanding faculty includes globally recognized leaders in their fields. And education and outreach are mission-critical for us.
